mcp.client.claudeDesktop.step2: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json (merge it into mcpServers if you already have one):
mcp.client.claudeDesktop.step3: Save, then quit and reopen Claude Desktop. Moharrik's tools appear under the tools menu in a chat.
mcp.client.claudeAi.step1: On claude.ai open Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector (on Team and Enterprise plans an owner does this in Organization settings → Connectors). Name it Moharrik.
mcp.client.claudeAi.step2: Paste the MCP server URL, and choose No sign-in as the authentication:
mcp.client.claudeAi.step3: Under Request headers choose authorization and paste this value, "Bearer " included, then Add:

notifications.hint: Alerts delivered by your webhook sources, newest first.
notifications.emptyBody: Add a webhook source and point GitHub, Sentry or anything else at it.
notifications.sourcesHint: Named, signed endpoints. Point GitHub, Sentry or anything else that can send a webhook at one.
notifications.addSourceHint: A signing secret is generated for it and shown once, after you create it.
notifications.deleteSourceBody: {name} stops accepting deliveries immediately. Its past notifications stay, unlinked.
notifications.noSourcesBody: Add one to get a URL and a signing secret.
notifications.secretHint: Put the URL and secret wherever the sending platform asks for a webhook.
notifications.shownOnce: This secret is shown once. If you lose it, rotate the source for a new one.
notifications.kindHint.generic: Your own services. Every delivery is signed together with a timestamp, and anything more than 5 minutes old is refused.
notifications.kindHint.github: A repository or organisation webhook. GitHub signs every delivery with the secret you give it.
notifications.kindHint.sentry: A Sentry internal integration. Sentry generates the secret, so you paste it in after creating the integration.
notifications.howTo.generic: Send two headers with every delivery: X-Webhook-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-Webhook-Signature (sha256= followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + "." + body, keyed with the secret). Deliveries more than 5 minutes old are refused, so a captured one can't be replayed.
notifications.howTo.github: In GitHub, open Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Payload URL: the URL above. Content type: application/json. Secret: the secret above. GitHub signs each delivery (X-Hub-Signature-256).
notifications.howTo.sentry: In Sentry, open Settings → Developer Settings → Custom Integrations → Create New Integration → Internal Integration. Webhook URL: the URL above. Turn on Alert Rule Action and subscribe to Issue. Save it, then paste its Client Secret below. Sentry signs each delivery with it (Sentry-Hook-Signature).
notifications.sentryHint: Sentry makes the signing secret, not Moharrik. Create the integration with this URL, then paste its Client Secret here.
notifications.clientSecretHint: Paste the Client Secret of the Sentry integration that sends to {name}. It replaces the current one straight away.
notifications.noSecretYet: No client secret yet. Every delivery is refused until you paste Sentry's.
notifications.legacySigningHint: This source predates timestamped signing and still accepts a signature over the body alone, which a captured delivery can repeat.
notifications.legacySigningHintPlatform: This source predates the change and still accepts the old X-Webhook-Signature header as well as its platform's own.
notifications.noLegacyDelivery: No legacy-signed delivery since the change.
notifications.switchSigningBody: From now on every delivery must send X-Webhook-Timestamp and sign timestamp + "." + body. A sender still signing the body alone will be refused. This can't be switched back.
notifications.switchSigningBodyPlatform: From now on only the platform's own signature is accepted, not the old X-Webhook-Signature header. This can't be switched back.
inbox.hint: One conversation per customer, whatever channel they arrived on.
inbox.emptyBody: Add a chat widget and put it on your site; messages land here.
inbox.pickOne: Pick a conversation to read it.
inbox.readOnly: You can read this conversation but not reply to it.
inbox.widgetsHint: An embeddable chat box. Its key is public — the origin allow-list is what protects it.
inbox.addWidgetHint: Paste the snippet it gives you on the site you want to chat from.
inbox.allowedOriginsHint: Comma separated, e.g. https://example.com. With none set the widget is blocked.
inbox.noOrigins: No origins set — this widget is blocked
inbox.noWidgetsBody: Add one to get a snippet you can paste on your site.

inbox.crm.title: In your CRM
inbox.crm.autoHint.email: Linked because the sender's email address is exactly this contact's.
inbox.crm.autoHint.phone: Linked because the sender's phone number has exactly this contact's digits.
inbox.crm.linkTitle: Link this conversation to a contact
inbox.crm.linkHint: Search your contacts by name, email or phone.
inbox.crm.createTitle: Create a contact from this conversation
inbox.crm.createHint: Filled in from what the visitor gave. If the email already belongs to a contact, that contact is linked instead and only its blank fields are filled.
inbox.crm.emailRequired: An email is required: every contact has one.
inbox.crm.reused: That email already belonged to {who}, who is now linked
inbox.crm.dealTitle: Open a deal from this conversation
inbox.crm.dealHint: The whole transcript (who said what, and when) is attached as the deal's first note.
inbox.crm.dealNoContact: No contact is linked, so this deal will not be on anyone's timeline. Link or create a contact first to put it there.
inbox.crm.dealOpened: Deal opened with the transcript attached
inbox.snoozedOpenEnded: Snoozed until the customer writes again
inbox.snoozeHint: It comes back to Open, unread, at that time, or sooner if the customer writes.
inbox.canned.inLanguage: Inserts the {language} text: this conversation is in {language}.
inbox.canned.hint: Answers your team sends again and again, in English and Arabic. The inbox inserts the one in the customer's language; nothing is sent until you press Send.
inbox.canned.titleHint: What your team sees in the picker. Never sent.
inbox.canned.bodyHint: Write one or both. When a conversation's language has no text, the other is inserted.
inbox.canned.deleteBody: {title} disappears from everyone's picker. Replies already sent are not affected.
inbox.canned.emptyBody: Add the answers your team types most, in English and Arabic.
inbox.canned.readOnly: Only managers can change canned replies; everyone can insert them.
inbox.stats.title: Inbox stats
inbox.stats.hint: Conversations started in the window, per channel, straight from your inbox.
inbox.stats.noDataBody: No conversation started in the last {n} days. The numbers appear as soon as one does.
inbox.stats.method: First response runs from the customer's first message to the team's first reply after it; unanswered conversations count as awaiting, not as zero. Resolved means closed now; time to resolve runs from start to close.
trends.hint: What your sources are saying, as stories: the same news from different outlets grouped, ranked with the reasons, and summarised.
trends.emptyBody: Add a source from the catalog and the collector starts filing what it publishes.
trends.sourcesHint: Where trends come from, how often each source is read, and the keyword topics that make a story relevant to you.
trends.feedsHint: Each source is read on its own schedule. Anything new is filed, and stories are regrouped.
trends.noFeedsBody: Pick one from the catalog below, or add any RSS or Atom URL. It is read once immediately so you can see it worked.
trends.feedDeleted: The source and its items were removed.
trends.deleteFeedBody: {name} and everything collected from it are removed. This cannot be undone.
trends.topicsHint: Words that make a story relevant to you. A story that mentions one ranks higher and shows it as a reason.
trends.noTopicsBody: Add a topic to label what you care about. Items already collected are labelled too.
trends.keywordsHint: Comma separated. With none, the topic matches its own name.
trends.topicCreated: Topic added — it matched {n} items already collected.
trends.deleteTopicBody: {name} stops labelling items. The items themselves stay.
automation.hint: Browsers paired with this workspace, and what they were asked to do.
automation.browsersHint: Each browser runs the extension and holds its own token. It can only be driven to the hosts you allow.
automation.noBrowsersBody: Install the extension in the browser you want to automate, point it at this workspace, and approve the code it shows.
automation.offlineHint: That browser is not connected right now.
automation.noHostsYet: No host allowed yet — this browser cannot be driven anywhere until you add one.
automation.allowedHostsHint: Comma separated. A host also allows its subdomains. Empty allows nothing.
automation.revokeBody: {name} loses its token immediately and its connection is dropped. It would have to pair again.
automation.revoked: That browser was revoked and disconnected.
automation.stopBody: Every run that is queued or going is cancelled, every browser is disconnected, and nothing new can start until you resume.
automation.stopped: Automation is stopped for this workspace.
automation.pausedBody: Nothing runs until someone resumes it.
automation.runsHint: What each browser was asked to do, and what came back.
automation.runStarted: The run started. It updates as each step answers.
automation.stepsHint: Each step is one thing the browser does. A step that opens a page is refused unless its host is on the browser's allowed sites.
automation.stepsNotArray: Steps must be a non-empty array.
mailbox.title: Email channel
mailbox.hint: Point this workspace at a mailbox. Anything unread there is filed in the inbox, and replies go out through your SMTP settings.
mailbox.notConfigured: No mailbox yet — email is not being collected.
mailbox.managerOnly: Only a manager can change where email is collected from.
mailbox.passwordHint: Stored encrypted. Many providers need an app password rather than your account one.
mailbox.passwordKeep: A password is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
mailbox.removeBody: The connection is removed. Conversations already collected stay in the inbox.
mailbox.removed: Email is no longer being collected.
mailbox.replyHint: Replies are sent with your workspace SMTP settings, threaded under the customer's own message.
mailbox.noneWarning: The password is sent in the clear. Only use this for a mail server on the same machine or a trusted network.
whatsapp.title: WhatsApp channel
whatsapp.hint: Link a WhatsApp number and customer messages arrive in the inbox, where the team answers from the same thread.
whatsapp.unavailableBody: This deployment has no WhatsApp server configured, so a number cannot be linked yet.
whatsapp.scanHint: On the phone: WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this.
whatsapp.scanExpires: The code expires after about a minute. Press the button again for a new one.
whatsapp.qrAlt: QR code to link a WhatsApp number
whatsapp.unlinkBody: The phone session is ended and nothing more arrives from it. Conversations already collected stay in the inbox.
whatsapp.replyHint: Replies from a WhatsApp thread are sent from the linked number.
automation.schedulesHint: A sequence of steps run on a clock. The browser has to be connected at the time — when it is not, the miss is recorded with its reason.
automation.noSchedulesBody: Add a schedule to run a sequence every day, every hour, or on any cron expression.
automation.cronHint: Five-field cron, or @daily / @hourly. "0 7 * * *" is 07:00 every day.
automation.timezoneHint: The time is read in this zone, so it stays right when the clocks change.
automation.catchUpHint: "Run once when it returns" suits a daily report. "Let it go" suits a routine chore you do not want eleven of.
automation.deleteScheduleBody: {name} stops running. Runs it already made stay.
automation.workflowsHint: A sequence worth keeping, with {{placeholders}} for the parts that change. Run it without retyping the steps.
automation.noWorkflowsBody: Save a sequence here and it can be run by anyone with the right role, or on a schedule.
automation.workflowStepsHint: A JSON array of steps. Write {{name}} anywhere a value should be supplied when it runs.
automation.secretParamsHint: Comma separated. A secret value is typed hidden and is redacted from the run record.
automation.deleteWorkflowBody: {name} is removed. Runs it already produced stay.
campaigns.internalNameHint: Only your team sees this. WhatsApp messages have no subject.
campaigns.whatsappBodyHint: Plain text. A line telling people how to stop (reply STOP) is added to every message automatically.
campaigns.reachable: This broadcast would reach {count} contacts on WhatsApp right now.
campaigns.reachableRule: Only contacts on the list who haven't unsubscribed, opted in to WhatsApp themselves, haven't replied STOP, and have a phone number. Being on the list is not WhatsApp consent.
campaigns.reachableError: Couldn't count who this would reach.
campaigns.whatsappMissing: No WhatsApp number is linked to this workspace, so a WhatsApp campaign can't be sent yet. Drafts can be saved meanwhile.
campaigns.whatsappMissingMember: No WhatsApp number is linked to this workspace yet; ask a manager to link one before sending.
campaigns.sendBodyWhatsApp: "{subject}" goes on WhatsApp to the {count} contacts on {list} who opted in to WhatsApp. Messages are paced, and each one tells people how to stop. This can't be undone.
campaigns.sendNobodyWhatsApp: Nobody on {list} can be reached on WhatsApp yet: no one there has opted in to WhatsApp with a phone number. Record opt-ins on the Contacts page first.
contacts.waOptInBody: Only do this if {who} agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from you. Joining a mailing list is not that agreement.
contacts.waOptInNoPhone: They have no phone number yet, so broadcasts won't reach them until one is added.
contacts.waReverseBody: {who} replied STOP and asked not to receive WhatsApp messages. Reverse it only if they have since asked, themselves, to be messaged again. They will be back in WhatsApp broadcasts.
contacts.waReverseConfirm: Yes, they asked to be let back in
contacts.waReversed: STOP reversed — they can receive WhatsApp broadcasts again

forms.dialogHint: Choose which list it fills and which websites may use it.
forms.name: Name
forms.allowedOriginsHint: One origin per line, e.g. https://example.com. Only pages on these origins can submit the form.
forms.noOrigins: No websites allowed: while this is empty, no site can submit this form.
forms.noOriginsShort: None — no site can submit this form
forms.thanksHint: Shown to the visitor after they submit. Leave empty for the default, which tells them to confirm by email when the list uses double opt-in.
forms.embedHint: Paste this into a page on one of the allowed websites. WhatsApp consent is its own unticked box and is only sent with a phone number.

editor.heading: Heading
campaigns.editHint: Change anything until it's sent. Once sending starts, the campaign is fixed.
campaigns.editLocked: This campaign is now “{status}”, so it can no longer be edited.
campaigns.previewEmailHint: Exactly the email recipients get, unsubscribe footer included.
campaigns.previewWhatsAppHint: Exactly the message contacts get, with the stop line added to every broadcast.

campaigns.testWhatsAppHint: The message goes to this workspace's own linked WhatsApp number (your "Message yourself" chat), exactly as contacts will get it. Tests never go to another number.
campaigns.testUnsaved: A test sends the saved version. Save your changes first.
campaigns.testNotASend: A test isn't a send: the campaign stays a draft and its numbers don't change. Up to 10 tests an hour per campaign.
campaigns.testNeedsSmtp: Test emails need an SMTP service for this workspace.
campaigns.testNeedsWhatsApp: A WhatsApp test needs this workspace's number linked first; see above.
research.hint: Ask the open web a question. Moharrik searches, reads the top pages, and keeps every source it found, read or not.
research.capNoSearch: Web search isn't set up on this deployment, so research can't be started here. Past runs are still listed below.
research.capNoRead: Pages aren't opened on this deployment: a run lists what the search found, with each result's snippet.
research.capNoModel: Answers aren't summarised on this deployment, because no model is configured. You'll get the sources each run collected, to read yourself.
research.askPlaceholder: e.g. What changed in the EU AI Act for small companies this year?
research.askHint: In your own words. One run at a time per workspace; a run takes a minute or two.
research.started: Research started. This page follows it as it goes.
research.busy: A run is already going in this workspace. Only one runs at a time.
research.liveTitle: A run is already going. Only one runs at a time, so a new question waits until it finishes or is stopped.
research.emptyBody: Ask a question above. Every page the search finds is kept here with its link, whether or not it could be read.
research.progressSearching: Searching the web and opening the first result…
research.progressReading: Reading the pages: {checked} checked, {read} read so far…
research.progressHint: Sources appear below as each page is opened. You can leave this page; the run carries on.
research.cancelledBody: It was not summarised. The sources collected before it stopped are below.
research.cancelledEmpty: It stopped before any source was collected.
research.nothingFound: The search found nothing for this question.
research.answerBy: Written by {model} from the sources below, and only those. The numbers link to them.
research.answerFrom: Written from the sources below, and only those. The numbers link to them.
research.noModelBody: No model is configured on this deployment, so there is no written answer. The sources this run collected are below: follow a link, or open the text of a page that was read.
research.notSummarisedBody: The sources were collected, but no answer could be written from them. The reason:
research.sourcesHint: Every result the search returned, in its rank order. The top ones are opened and read; the rest stand on their snippet.
research.notOpened: Not opened: only the top results are read. This one stands on its snippet.
research.textEmpty: The page was read but no text was kept.
forms.readOnly: Only managers and above can create and change website forms.
forms.needList: To add a subscribe form, create a list on the Contacts page first.
forms.dialogHintInquiry: Visitors send their name, email, phone, company and a message. Each one becomes a lead, with the campaign, referrer and landing page it came from.
forms.thanksHintInquiry: Shown to the visitor after they send. Leave empty for the default, which says the message arrived and you will be in touch.
forms.embedHintInquiry: Paste this into a page on one of the allowed websites. It remembers the UTM parameters, gclid, referrer and landing page of the visit, and sends them with the message. A hidden field catches bots.
forms.deleteBodyInquiry: "{name}" stops working on every site it's embedded on. Leads it already filed stay on the Leads page.
leads.hint: Inquiries from the forms on your websites, with where each visitor came from. Convert one to make the contact, company and deal in one step.
leads.emptyBody: Create an inquiry form, allow your website, and paste its embed code on your contact page. Every message sent through it lands here.
leads.emptyBodyMember: Leads arrive here when a manager puts an inquiry form on your website.
leads.notFoundBody: It may have been in another workspace, or the link is wrong.
leads.noAttribution: Nothing recorded: the visitor came straight to the site, or the form was embedded without the snippet's attribution.
leads.convertedWithCompany: Contact, company ({company}) and deal are ready, with the message on the timeline.
leads.convertedFreeMail: Contact and deal are ready. No company: the address is free mail.
leads.spamNoConvert: Marked as spam — change the status to convert it.
integrations.hint: Connect the outside accounts this workspace reads from.
integrations.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can see or change this workspace's integrations.
integrations.googleHint: Connect the Google accounts this business uses for Analytics, Search Console and YouTube. Each connect opens Google so you can choose the account, and adding a product to an account that is already connected keeps the ones it has. Moharrik only reads, plus submitting sitemaps in Search Console.
integrations.notConfigured: Google is not configured on this server yet.
integrations.notConfiguredBody: An operator needs to set GOOGLE_INTEGRATIONS_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_INTEGRATIONS_CLIENT_SECRET, and register the redirect URI below on that OAuth client. Until then there is nothing to connect.
integrations.noneBody: Connect one above for the product you want.
integrations.product.analytics.hint: Read the GA4 reports of this account's properties.
integrations.product.search_console.hint: Search performance for this account's sites, and submitting sitemaps.
integrations.revenue: Also include revenue reports (for a monetised channel)
integrations.disconnectBody: Moharrik revokes its access at Google and forgets this account in this workspace. Anything that reads from it stops until it is connected again.
integrations.disconnected: Disconnected, and access revoked at Google.
integrations.disconnectedShared: Removed from this workspace. The same Google account is still connected elsewhere in Moharrik, so its access was not revoked at Google.
integrations.disconnectedNoRevoke: Removed from this workspace, but Google did not confirm the revoke. Remove Moharrik at myaccount.google.com/permissions to be sure.
integrations.statusReauthHint: Google no longer accepts this connection (access removed, or the password changed).
integrations.result.cancelled: The connection was cancelled at Google. Nothing was changed.
integrations.result.access_denied: Access was not allowed at Google, so nothing was connected.
integrations.result.state: That sign-in attempt expired or was already used. Start the connect again from this page.
integrations.result.forbidden: Only an owner or admin of this workspace can connect Google accounts.
integrations.result.failed: Google could not be connected. Try again, and if it keeps failing, report it.
integrations.result.no_refresh: Google did not grant lasting access, so nothing was connected. Try again and approve the request.
integrations.result.scope: {product} needs every box on Google's screen ticked. Nothing was connected; try again and leave them ticked.
integrations.result.no_identity: Google did not say which account this is, so nothing was connected. Try again.
integrations.result.not_configured: Google is not configured on this server yet.
lists.editHint: Rename the list or change how new contacts join it.
lists.doubleOptInEditHint: Applies to contacts added from now on. Turning it off doesn't confirm anyone already pending, and turning it on doesn't ask existing subscribers again.
contacts.noMatchBody: Try a different search, list or status.
contacts.unsubscribeBody: {who} will stop receiving {list} campaigns. They stay in your CRM, on their other lists, with their deals and history — nothing is deleted. Adding them back to this list later asks for their consent again if it uses double opt-in.
contacts.alreadyUnsubscribed: They were already unsubscribed from that list
contacts.unsubscribedByTeam: Unsubscribed by a team member on {date}
contacts.pickMore: Showing {shown} of {total} — keep typing to narrow it down
alerts.nothingToRead: Your role has no inbox or notifications to be alerted about.
delivery.hint: How this workspace reaches you when a customer writes: in an open tab, on your devices when none is open, and with a sound.
delivery.pushHint: Arrive even when no Moharrik tab is open.
delivery.enabled: Push is on for this device
delivery.disabled: Push is off for this device
delivery.unsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications.
delivery.notConfigured: Push isn't set up on this server yet (VAPID keys). Alerts still arrive in any open tab.
delivery.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser's settings.
delivery.desktopHint: A notification when a customer writes while Moharrik is in a background tab.
delivery.chimeHint: A short chime with each new customer message, in this browser.
delivery.devicesHint: Where push is on for you in this workspace. Only you see this list.
delivery.noDevices: Push isn't on for any of your devices yet.
delivery.testHint: Sends one to every device in this list.
overview.otherCurrency: {n} open deals in other currencies are counted but not added to the values.
overview.noNextCloses: No open deal has an expected close date from today on.
overview.noDealsBody: Open a deal and its value shows here, stage by stage.
overview.noLeadsBody: Leads arrive when a visitor sends the inquiry form on your website.
overview.noConversationsBody: Put a chat widget on your website and visitors' messages arrive here.
overview.noNotificationsBody: Connect a webhook source — GitHub, Sentry or your own system — and its events arrive here.
overview.noListsBody: Create a list to collect subscribers and send campaigns to them.
overview.noTopicsBody: Add topics with keywords, and matching news from your feeds shows here.
overview.noMatches: Nothing has matched your topics yet.
overview.noMatchesBody: Items appear as your feeds are collected. Check the keywords if this stays empty.
overview.setup.inquiry_form.hint: Turns your website's visitors into leads.
overview.setup.smtp.hint: Needed to send campaigns and confirmation emails.
overview.setup.chat_widget.hint: Lets visitors message you from your website.
overview.setup.whatsapp.hint: Receive and answer WhatsApp messages in the inbox.
overview.setup.google.hint: Brings in Analytics, Search Console and YouTube data.
overview.setup.browser.hint: Pair a browser so Moharrik can run tasks in it.
overview.limitedRole: Your role here doesn't include leads, deals, the inbox or campaigns. Ask an admin of this workspace if you need them.
automation.ext.title: Install the browser extension
automation.ext.hint: The extension is how a browser you use is paired with this workspace and driven through the steps you approve, on the sites you allow.
automation.ext.name: Moharrik extension {version}
automation.ext.devBody: This build pairs with {site}, a development server. Production builds are offered by the production site.
automation.ext.checksumHint: To check the download matches, run one of these where you saved it:
automation.ext.installHint: It is not in the Chrome Web Store, so it is loaded as an unpacked extension. This takes a minute, once.
automation.ext.s1Title: Unzip it into a folder you will keep
automation.ext.s1Body: Chrome loads the extension from that folder every time it starts. Deleting or moving the folder removes the extension.
automation.ext.s2Body: Paste this into the address bar. Browsers do not let a website link to it.
automation.ext.s2Other: In Edge it is edge://extensions, in Brave brave://extensions.
automation.ext.s3Body: The switch is in the corner of the extensions page. It only allows loading an unpacked extension; it changes nothing else.
automation.ext.s4Title: Press "Load unpacked" and choose the folder
automation.ext.s4Body: Choose the folder that has manifest.json in it. Moharrik appears in the list with its version.
automation.ext.s5Body: Open the puzzle-piece menu next to the address bar and pin Moharrik, so its button is always one click away.
automation.ext.pairHint: Connecting gives this browser its own token. An admin approves it on this site, in a page the extension opens — nothing is copied between screens.
automation.ext.s6Title: Press “Connect to the site” in the extension
automation.ext.s6Body: Click the Moharrik button next to the address bar, then “Connect to the site”. It opens an approval page on this site in a new tab.
automation.ext.s7Body: On that page, choose this workspace, name the browser, list the sites it may be driven on, and press Approve. The extension picks up its token by itself.
automation.ext.s7AskAdmin: Only an admin of this workspace can approve a browser. Ask one to press “Connect to the site” in the extension on that browser.
automation.ext.seeBrowsers: See them on the Automation page
automation.ext.updateBody: A browser on an older version is flagged on the Automation page. Download the new zip, unzip it over the same folder, and press the reload arrow on Moharrik's card in the extensions page. It stays paired.
automation.sched.needBrowserTitle: A schedule needs a paired browser
automation.sched.needBrowserBody: Schedules run in a browser paired with this workspace, and none is paired yet. Install the extension and pair a browser first.
trends.summary.extractive: An excerpt from the coverage itself; no model wrote it.
trends.summary.headlines: The story as the other outlets headlined it.
trends.summary.model: Summarised by {model} from the headlines and excerpts.
trends.summary.none: One headline with no excerpt: the headline is the story so far.
trends.budgetHint: Every read, scheduled or by hand, spends one. When today's budget is spent, sources wait until tomorrow (UTC).
trends.budgetScheduled: Your schedules ask for {n} a day.
trends.budgetShort: Your schedules ask for more than the budget, so some sources will wait until tomorrow.
trends.budgetChangeHint: How many reads a day this workspace's sources may spend in total, between 1 and {max}.
trends.catalogHint: Hand-picked feeds and APIs in English and Arabic. One click adds a source and reads it straight away.
trends.addByUrlHint: Any RSS or Atom feed. It is read once now, so a wrong URL is caught while you are here.
trends.fetchedOverBudget: Today's collection budget is spent. Raise it, or the source is read again tomorrow.
trends.editTopicHint: Items are relabelled and every recent story is rescored.
resources.title: What this workspace reads
resources.hint: Every property, site and channel your connected accounts can see. Switch on the ones this workspace should read; several of each are allowed. When an account can see only one, it is switched on for you.
resources.chooseBody: Your accounts can see several of these, so Moharrik did not guess: switch on the ones this workspace should read — {kinds}.
resources.discoveryFailed: Moharrik could not list this account's {product}.
resources.unavailable: No longer visible to this account
automation.field.all: Every match, not just the first
automation.editor.title: Workflow
automation.editor.hint: Change the steps, pick elements on the live page, test it in a paired browser, and save. Every save is kept as a version.
automation.editor.noAccess: Your role cannot see automation in this workspace.
automation.editor.stepsHint: Drag a step by its handle, or use the arrows, to change the order. Write {{name}} wherever a value should be asked for when it runs.
automation.editor.unknownCommand: The browser does not know this command; choose one it does.
automation.editor.continueOnError: Carry on if this step fails
automation.editor.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
automation.editor.needStep: A workflow needs at least one step.
automation.editor.created: The workflow was saved as v1.
automation.editor.testHint: Runs the steps as they are on this page, saved or not, in a paired browser. Each step's result shows on its row as it arrives.
automation.editor.noBrowser: No browser is paired with this workspace yet.
automation.editor.testStale: The steps changed after this test, so its results are not shown on the rows.
automation.pick.title: Pick the element on the page
automation.pick.body: Your browser opens this page in a new tab. Click the element the step should use — the click is not passed to the page. Press Esc there to cancel.
automation.pick.needUrl: Give a full address, with any {{placeholders}} filled in.
automation.pick.pickedFragile: Picked {selector}. It depends on the element's position, so a change to the page may break it.
automation.params.title: Values it asks for
automation.params.hint: The {{placeholders}} in the steps. A secret value is typed hidden, left out of the run record, and never shown again once a schedule keeps it.
automation.params.undeclared: Used in the steps but not described here: {names}
automation.params.name: Placeholder
automation.params.label: Label
automation.params.badName: "{name}" cannot be a placeholder name: use letters, digits and _.
automation.versions.title: Versions
automation.versions.hint: Every save is kept. Restoring one saves its steps again as the newest version, so a restore can be undone too.
automation.versions.confirmBody: The steps and values of v{n} become the workflow again, saved as v{next}. Nothing is deleted.
automation.versions.confirmDirty: Changes you have not saved on this page are dropped.
automation.sched.noWorkflows: A schedule runs a saved workflow, and there is none yet.
automation.sched.workflowHint: What runs, with the values below.
automation.sched.secretHint: Kept sealed and never shown again, not even to you.
automation.sched.zoneHint: The workspace's is {zone}. The time is read in this zone, so it stays right when the clocks change.
automation.sched.deletedWorkflow: a workflow that no longer exists
automation.flow.title: Set up a browser
automation.flow.hint: Three steps, once per browser: install the extension, connect it to this workspace, and say which sites it may be driven on.
automation.flow.install.title: Install the extension
automation.flow.install.body: Download the zip and load it unpacked in Chrome, Edge or Brave. The install page walks through it.
automation.flow.install.done: Installed. Download it again to set up another browser or to update one.
automation.flow.pair.title: Connect it to this workspace
automation.flow.pair.body: In the extension, press “Connect to the site”. It opens an approval page on this site where you choose this workspace and approve it.
automation.flow.pair.done: {n} browser(s) connected. Connect another the same way.
automation.flow.sites.title: Say where it may go
automation.flow.sites.waiting: Once a browser is paired, list the sites it may be driven on. Until then it can go nowhere.
automation.flow.sites.body: A paired browser may go nowhere until you list its sites. Add at least one below.
automation.flow.sites.done: Each browser can only be driven on the sites listed with it.
automation.flow.runsNeedBrowser: Runs appear here once a paired browser has done something.
automation.flow.pair.askAdmin: An admin of this workspace approves new browsers: they press “Connect to the site” in the extension on the browser being connected.
automation.connect.title: Connect this browser?
automation.connect.hint: A Moharrik extension asked to connect. Approve it only if you just pressed “Connect to the site” in the extension, on a browser in front of you.
automation.connect.checkCode: Check this code matches the extension
automation.connect.claimsHint: This is what the browser says about itself; none of it is verified. The request expires {date}.
automation.connect.workspaceHint: The browser answers to this workspace only. Its admins can rename it, change its sites or revoke it.
automation.connect.workspaceHintSome: Only the workspaces where you are an admin are listed. The browser answers to the one you choose.
automation.connect.name: Name this browser
automation.connect.hostsHint: The sites it may be driven on, comma separated. A site also allows its subdomains. Leave it empty and it can go nowhere until you add some.
automation.connect.doneReplaced: {name} was already connected to {workspace}. It has a new token now, and the old one stopped working.
automation.connect.closeTab: You can close this tab. The extension picks up its connection by itself within a few seconds.
automation.connect.noSitesYet: It may not go anywhere yet: add its sites on the Automation page.
automation.connect.refusedBody: The extension was told. Nothing was connected.
automation.connect.notFoundBody: No browser is waiting with this code. Press “Connect to the site” in the extension again for a new one.
automation.connect.expiredBody: Nobody approved it within ten minutes. Press “Connect to the site” in the extension again.
automation.connect.noKeyBody: This link is missing the key the extension adds to it, so nothing can be approved from it. Press “Connect to the site” in the extension; it opens the right page itself.
automation.connect.noWorkspaceTitle: No workspace to connect it to
automation.connect.notAdminBody: Connecting a browser needs the admin role in a workspace, and you are not an admin in any. Ask an admin of your workspace to connect it, or create a workspace of your own.
automation.connect.noWorkspaceBody: You are not in any workspace yet. Create one, then press “Connect to the site” in the extension again.
automation.connect.signInFirst: Sign in to decide whether this browser may connect to one of your workspaces.
deals.relatedMore: Showing the first {shown} of {total} deals. See them all on the Deals page.
companies.pickMore: Showing {shown} of {total} — keep typing to narrow it down
campaigns.audienceTooLarge: This list has {count} recipients. One send reaches at most {max}, so it will be refused. Split the list and send each part.
campaigns.audienceLimit: One send reaches at most {max} recipients.
charts.table: Show the numbers as a table
gdata.stale: Showing what Google answered {when}: it could not be asked just now.
gdata.askAdmin: An owner or admin of this workspace can set this up in Settings → Integrations.
gdata.noAccess: Your role in this workspace cannot read its analytics.
gdata.choose.ga4_property: Choose which Analytics property to read
gdata.choose.gsc_site: Choose which Search Console site to read
gdata.choose.yt_channel: Choose which YouTube channel to read
gdata.connectBody: Connect the Google account that has access in Settings → Integrations. When it can see just one, it is read straight away.
gdata.chooseBody: Your connected accounts can see several, so switch on the ones this workspace should read.
analytics.hint: Your Google Analytics 4 numbers: who came, how often and from where.
analytics.trendNote: Days in the property's time zone ({tz}). Today is left out until it is complete.
analytics.noPages: No page views in this window.
analytics.emptyTitle: No data in this window yet
analytics.emptyBody: Google Analytics has nothing for this property between {from} and {to}. A new property takes a day or two to show data, and none arrives until the GA4 tag is on the site.
overview.trafficPending: Not fetched from Google Analytics yet.
gsc.hint: How your site shows up in Google Search: clicks, impressions, click-through rate and position.
gsc.importing: The first import from Search Console is running. The newest days arrive first; this page fills in as they do.
gsc.notImported: Nothing has been imported from Search Console yet.
gsc.emptyTitle: No search data in this window
gsc.emptyBody: Search Console has no clicks or impressions for this site in this window. A new or unverified site takes a few days to collect data.
gsc.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches these filters in this window.
gsc.lag: Search Console data arrives two to three days late
gsc.basisQueries: Filtered by query or page: these totals add up the queries Google names, and leave out the anonymised ones, so they are lower than the site's totals.
gsc.truncated: {n} busy days had more query rows than one import keeps; their totals are complete, their query lists are the top rows only.
gsc.positionNote: Lower is better: position 1 is the top of the results, so the axis runs downwards.
overview.searchPending: Not imported from Search Console yet.
gsc.missing: {n} days of this window are not imported yet, so these totals are partial.
gsc.prevMissing: The period before is still being imported ({n} days to go), so nothing is compared yet.
resources.filter: Find a property, site or channel
yt.hint: Your channel as YouTube reports it: every upload, and what viewers are saying.
yt.firstSync: Reading the channel from YouTube for the first time. The uploads appear in a moment.
yt.notSynced: The channel has not been read from YouTube yet.
yt.quota: YouTube quota today: {used} of {limit} units for this workspace · {all} of {allLimit} for all of Moharrik. It resets at midnight Pacific time.
yt.noVideosBody: This channel has not uploaded any videos.
yt.commentsDisabled: Comments are turned off for this video.
yta.title: YouTube Analytics
yta.pending: YouTube publishes each day's numbers a day or two late; the last {n} days are not in yet and are left as a gap.
yta.emptyBody: YouTube Analytics has nothing for this window yet. A new channel or video takes a couple of days to show numbers.
yt.youtubeCounts: YouTube's counter says {n}; {p} of these are public
yt.countHint: The channel's own counter (statistics.videoCount) counts public videos only, and YouTube updates it on its own schedule, so it can differ from the uploads Moharrik read.
yt.commentsUnavailable: Comments cannot be read on this server yet: Google only lets them be read with a YouTube API key when Moharrik has read-only access to the channel. An operator can add one (YOUTUBE_API_KEY).
yt.commentsNotPublic: This video is not public, so its comments cannot be read with read-only access.
gsci.hint: Ask Google how it sees one page of {site}: whether it is indexed, when it was last crawled, and which canonical Google chose.
gsci.managerOnly: A manager or above of this workspace can do this.
gsci.quota: {used} of {limit} inspections used today for this site (Google's daily budget per site, shared by every workspace that reads it).
gsci.noneBody: Paste a page's address above to see how Google sees it.
gscs.hint: The sitemaps Google knows for this site, read from Google now. Submitting one asks Google to read it (again).
gscs.submitted: Sent to Google. It reads the sitemap in its own time.
gscs.noneBody: Submit the site's sitemap so Google finds every page.
ytr.title: Daily reports
ytr.hint: YouTube Reporting's daily CSV reports for this channel: channel totals, traffic sources, and devices. Google keeps them 60 days; Moharrik keeps a copy.
ytr.noJobs: This channel has no report jobs yet.
ytr.notChecked: Not checked with YouTube yet: this happens with the channel's next sync.
ytr.jobWaiting: Job created {when}. YouTube publishes the first reports about two days after a job is created.
